evidence.quote: LAB18.b is located between local ULIRGs (cite: clements18) and local gas-poor, early-type galaxies (cite: cortese14).

claims.finding: LAB18.b is not a typical DSFG but is in transition to a gas-poor early-type galaxy

evidence.quote: These suggest that LAB18.b is not a typical DSFG but in a transition phase from a DSFGs to a gas-poor, early-type galaxy.
